evidence: CVE Services record https://cveawg.mitre.org/api/cve/CVE-2026-77639 is state=PUBLISHED (not rejected/withdrawn). CNA description: concatenated gzip/zlib sub-streams each just under the per-stream detection threshold bypass the compression-bomb check (TROVE-2026-022). Affected: Tor 0.3.1.1-alpha inclusive to before 0.4.9.9. CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:L.

Vendor ChangeLog at tag tor-0.4.9.9: 'Fix a compression bomb bypass where an attacker could concatenate many gzip or zlib sub-streams, each just under the per-stream detection threshold, to avoid the compression bomb check entirely. TROVE-2026-022. Fixes bug 41275; bugfix on 0.3.1.1-alpha.'

Source-to-sink in the assigned clone: directory HTTP bodies are passed to tor_uncompress() from src/feature/dirclient/dirclient.c (declared and guessed compression methods). tor_uncompress() calls tor_compress_impl(). On TOR_COMPRESS_DONE with remaining input, tor_compress_impl() does tor_compress_free()+tor_compress_new(), which allocates a fresh zlib backend whose input_so_far/output_so_far start at zero. Backend tor_zlib_compress_process() only runs tor_compress_is_compression_bomb() on those per-state counters, and the helper returns 0 while size_out < CHECK_FOR_COMPRESSION_BOMB_AFTER (5 MiB at fix time). The outer BUFFER_FULL check uses in_len_orig (total original input, including unconsumed later members) so concatenated members inflate the denominator. A malicious relay can therefore keep each member under the per-stream size gate while cumulative client allocation grows.
GHSA-jm5p-g55h-rwhg withdrawn_at is null; GitHub withdrawn_at is not treated as authoritative. CVE.org remains PUBLISHED.

Parent 91dd4a00f7d4891e24187a849933547128aeeb9f has no tor_compress_impl(). gzip/zlib one-shot decompression is tor_zlib_uncompress() in src/common/compress_zlib.c, which on Z_STREAM_END with avail_in != 0 does inflateEnd()+inflateInit2() on the same z_stream and checks tor_compress_is_compression_bomb(in_len, out_size) using the original total input length and cumulative output allocation. That path never constructs a new tor_compress_state_t and therefore never zeroes streaming input_so_far/output_so_far.
